paite: Huchi in Solomon athum khit in van a kipan mei ahong kesuk a, halmang thillat leh kithoihnate ahong kangmangta a, huan TOUPA thupina'n inn adimta hi.
heading: Tempul Latna / (1 Kum 8.62-66)
english: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and Yahweh’s glory filled the house.

paite: TOUPA thupina in TOUPA' inn adimsak ziak in TOUPA' inn ah siampute alut thei kei uhi.
english: The priests could not enter into Yahweh’s house, because Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

paite: Israel suante in van a kipan a mei hong lengsuk leh inn tung a TOUPA thupina a-en nilouh ua, suanglep tung ah mai a lei si in abokkhup ua, TOUPA phat in abia uhi. "Amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi," chi in chibai abuk ua, kipahthu agen uhi.
english: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to Yahweh, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”

paite: Kumpipa leh mipite'n TOUPA ma ah kithoihnate alan uhi.
english: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before Yahweh.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in kithoihna bawngtal singnih-le-sangnih leh belam nuaikhat-le-singnih alan uhi. Huchibang in kumpipa leh mipite'n Pathian inn alan uhi.
english: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

paite: Huan siampute amun chiat uah adingh ua; Levite leng TOUPA kiang a kipahthu genna ding a phuah, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi, chi a TOUPA phatna dia David in azat sek, thil ging thei toh TOUPA lasa in adingh ua; huchi in siampute'n pengkul amut ua, Israel mi tengteng adingh diamduam uhi.
english: The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of Yahweh, which David the king had made to give thanks to Yahweh, when David praised by their ministry, saying “For his loving kindness endures forever.” The priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA' inn mazawn a um sung kongtual ahihsiangthou behlap a; huai ah halmang thillatte, lemna thillat thaute alan a; Solomon dal maitam bawl halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, thaute latna ding a aneu luat ziak in.
english: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before Yahweh’s house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.

paite: Huchi in huai tung in Solomon leh Israel mi tengteng mipi kikaikhawm thupitak Hamath kholutna a kipan a Aigupta gam lui pha a mite toh ni sagih ankuang alui uhi.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

paite: Ani giat ni in kikhopna tak anei ua; maitam kipahpihna ding in ni sagih azang ua, ankuanglui ni a ding in ni sagih azang uhi.
english: On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

paite: Huchi in akha sagihna ani sawmnih-le-thum ni in mipite akikhensak a, TOUPA'N David leh Solomon leh ami Israelte tung a ahoihna alatsak ziak in nuamsatak leh kipaktak in mite a-inn lam chiat uah apaita uhi.
english: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that Yahweh had shown to David, to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

paite: Huchibang in, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn apichinta a; Solomon in alungsim a atup bang in TOUPA' inn leh ama inn lamzangtak in apichinta hi.
heading: Solomon Kiang A TOUPA Kilak Nawnna / (1 Kum 9.1-9)
english: Thus Solomon finished Yahweh’s house and the king’s house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in Yahweh’s house and in his own house.

paite: Huan zan in Solomon kiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Na thumna ka za a, hiai mun kei a ding in kithoihna inn ding in ka sep khin hi.
english: Then Yahweh appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice.

paite: Vante ka khak a, vuahte azuk louh in hiam, khaukhup ka sawl a, gamte ahihsiat hiam, ka mite lak a hipi ka lensak hiam a;
english: “If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people,

paite: ka min pu ka mite kingaineu a athum ua, ahon zon ua, a-omdan giloute uh alehngatsan uleh van a kipan in ka na ngaikhe ding a, akhelhna uh ka ngaidam ding a, agam uh ka damsak ding hi.
english: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

paite: Hiai mun a thumna ka mit ka suan ding a, ka bil ka doh ding hi.
english: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place.

paite: Huai a ka min tangtawn a a-omtheihna ding in hiai inn ka sep a, ka hihsingthouta hi: huai ah ka mit leh ka lungtang a-om tawntungta ding hi.
english: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually.

paite: Huan nang tungtang thu ah leng, na pa David bang a ka mitmuh a na om a, thu ka hon piak bang a na om a, ka dan thusehte leh ka vaihawmte na zuihleh:
english: “As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

paite: Israelte lak ah 'vaihawmmi na tasam kei ding,' chi a na pa David kiang a ka thukhun bang in 'na gam laltutphah ka kipsak ding hi.'
english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, according as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Israel.’

paite: Himahleh na kiheimang ua, ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte na lehngatsan ua, Pathian dangte nna na sep ua, na biak uleh:
english: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

paite: Amau ka piak gam a kipan ka hon hihmang ding a; hiai inn, ka min ding a ka hihsiangthousa, ka mitmuh phak louh ah ka suanmang ding a, nam chih lak a paunak leh aselam a gentehna ding in ka bawl ding hi.
english: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

paite: 'Hiai inn sangpi akiang a pai peuh in lamdang asa ding ua, bangchi a hiai gam leh hiai inn TOUPA'N hichi a hih ahia? achi ding uh.'
english: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land and to this house?’

paite: TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian, 'Aigupta gam a kipan pikhepa alehngatsan ua, Pathian dangte zui a, abiak ua, a-nnate asep ziak un hiai siatna tengteng atung uah atung ahi, ahon chi ding uh achi hi.'
english: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”
